verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment option. The only hosting reference describes Pipeline itself hosting integrations, which is vendor-hosted SaaS, and the public REST API and OpenAPI spec do not amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
